project.title: Seasons
project.description: Run your server in seasons on one world that never resets. Gear goes into a Hall of Fame, everyone restarts at a fresh spawn, and the old world unlocks at Homecoming.

gallery.title: Seasons
gallery.description: Every season ends. Its legends stay in the Hall of Fame.

gallery.title: How a season works
gallery.description: Play, the season ends, your gear goes into the Hall of Fame, everyone starts fresh far away, and Homecoming reopens the old world.

gallery.title: The Hall of Fame
gallery.description: One cell per player per season: a figure in your armour, a plaque, and your whole inventory on display, view-only.

gallery.title: The old world waits
gallery.description: Zones lock old seasons' land until the group votes for Homecoming, while the new spawn is far out in unexplored land.

gallery.title: Nothing is ever lost
gallery.description: Every item move is journalled first, so a crash leaves every item exactly once.
